designRules.rule: No Discord role, reaction, engagement count, or unpaid Checkout session is payment evidence.
A sovereign payment-provider receipt is input to TTI entitlement admission and never writes entitlement directly.
Every charged product has a bounded fulfillment promise and TTI-owned fulfillment receipts.
Profit requires externally settled revenue and all attributable costs; unknown never compiles to zero.
Historical islander access remains grandfathered and distinct from vault subscriber payment entitlement.
Member-private knowledge cannot route to a broader publication boundary without separate consent and provenance.
Raw Stripe bodies, signatures, API credentials, and webhook authority remain inside the sovereign payment-provider settlement; TTI admits only authenticated provider-authored receipts.

A checkout solicitation requires an authenticated Discord-account binding held locally by TTI; a caller-supplied user ID is not identity evidence and Discord identity does not cross the payment-provider boundary.
Synthetic provider receipts produce only synthetic nonposting entitlement decisions and can never mutate the live entitlement ledger, Discord, revenue, or profit.
Provider events are deduplicated by provider event identity and stale events cannot supersede newer entitlement evidence.

Opening a private checkout invitation is inert; only one affirmative POST may consume it, and a non-live submission records qualified interest without provider contact, charge, entitlement, revenue, or future purchase obligation.

A TTI-authored provider source observation or compatibility reading is neither a provider offer nor refusal; provider admission requires a content-addressed provider-authored offer, cost quote, capability evidence, and passing customer-side tests.

A provider offer crosses a dedicated authenticated boundary, is witnessed separately from TTI's qualification and operational-admission decisions, and binds immutable offer, checkout, webhook, and receipt-delivery contracts; authentication, offer qualification, test evidence, operational admission, or a cost quote never executes the contract or proves Checkout, payment, revenue, entitlement, realized cost, or profit. Only a non-synthetic operational admission backed by seven self-addressed TTI-observed test receipts may enter live activation.
